Genuinely absent, and BOTH are a product decision for Casey rather than code: (1) the one-click stake rail, which the frame draws as $5 -> Win $500 / $25 -> $2,500 / $100 -> $10,000, i.e. 100x, against a live rail that pays a measured fixed 2.000x on integer POINTS stakes 1..1000 (20260310000001_prediction_mini_game.sql); (2) the cents-per-share target ladder, which no venue prices. The ASSET also differs, not just the multiplier: modules/skai-landing/src/services/predictionService.ts is titled "ETH price feed + server-side bet placement/settlement" and is the rail's only client, while these frames draw BTC. So retargeting the family to the live rail changes asset, window AND pricing model. Do not fabricate either.
